nodes.title: PROMPT 1 / 8 (window 1) - its LATENT sets the length
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>. Only her arms and hands are visible: her pink gloves with their seams and stitching, and the rainbow cuffs at her wrists, exactly as in <Picture 1>.

summary:
[reference generation] Part 1 of 8 of a wild, high-speed first-person roller coaster ride through outer space, starting with a rocket launch that ejects her onto the track, with turns, a loop, a trip down to Mars, a hyperdrive jump to the Sun and a ride around a black hole. The camera is the rider's eyes; the only visible part of <Subject 1> is her two gloved hands and forearms in front of her. One continuous shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (hands and forearms throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - keep her pink gloves, their stitching, and her rainbow cuffs from <Picture 1> sharp and unchanged.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action rendering, cinematic, action-packed, with crisp fine detail and hard light.

[Shot 1] The camera is a first-person point of view from inside the cramped cockpit of a small silver rocket ship sitting on a launch pad, looking forward through a round window at a starry sky. <Subject 1> rests her pink gloved hands on a control panel full of small glowing switches, dials and blinking lights, the rainbow cuffs bright at her wrists. The rocket roars to life and shoots upward, the whole cockpit shaking hard, flames and smoke flashing past the window as the sky turns black and fills with sharp stars. A red light flashes, the hatch in front of her bursts open with a bang, and she is ejected out into open space: the view tumbles and spins through the stars as her gloved hands flail in front of the camera, the rocket streaking away with a long trail of fire. She drops down onto a roller coaster track floating in space and lands in the front seat of a waiting cart with a hard thump. The front edge of the cart settles at the bottom of the frame: a scratched red metal dashboard with a row of small round rivets, a white stenciled number "07", a small yellow warning label reading "KEEP HANDS INSIDE", a large round glowing blue button labeled "HYPERDRIVE" in the middle of the dashboard, and a padded black lap bar that swings down into place. The track is a pair of polished chrome rails on a dark steel spine, with evenly spaced riveted cross-ties, white stenciled segment numbers on every tenth tie, small glowing blue marker lights along both edges, and a lattice of grey steel support struts reaching down into space below it. She throws both arms up in front of the camera, her pink gloved hands open with the fingers spread, and the cart starts rolling forward and rises into a long steep climb, the lift chain clanking under it. The camera shakes strongly at fast speed through the launch and the landing, then steadies as the cart climbs, the stitching on her gloves and the colors of the rainbow cuffs clear.

overall_soundscape:
The deep roar of the rocket engines and the bang of the hatch blowing open, then a hard thump as she lands in the cart. The loud metallic roar and rattle of the cart's wheels on the chrome rails, hard clanks over the cross-ties, rushing whooshes at every drop and turn, and the woman's breathless screams and wild laughter.

N/A

Photorealistic live-action rendering with the same character appearance as the references, placed against the background from <Picture 2>. Soft, even studio lighting matches the backdrop. [Shot 1] A medium-wide shot frames <Subject 1> standing in the center of the frame, full body visible from head to knees, in front of the colorful paneled backdrop from <Picture 2>. She faces the camera with a bright, open smile, her arms relaxed at her sides and her pink hair resting on her shoulders. She raises her right gloved hand to shoulder height and waves at the camera three times, her rainbow cuff swinging slightly with each wave. She lowers her hand, shifts her weight onto her toes, and begins a slow spin to her left in place. Her winged costume fans outward as she turns, showing her side, then her back, then her other side, while her pink hair swings out and settles. She completes the full turn and comes back to face the camera, planting her feet shoulder-width apart. She places both gloved hands on her hips, tilts her head slightly to the right, and holds the pose with a wide smile, her red clown nose catching the light. She stays still in this pose until the end of the shot, centered in the frame in front of the backdrop.

Quiet room tone, with the soft rustle of her costume as she turns and the light tap of her shoes on the floor.

nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
HOW TO USE

Space roller coaster: rocket launch ejects her onto the track, loop-de-loop, turns, ghost space stingrays she reaches out to, down to Mars, she hits the HYPERDRIVE button, ride over the Sun, then around a black hole. 1433 frames = 60 s, 8 windows of 226 frames. Press Run.

8 PROMPT nodes (bottom), one per window, joined in order by the Conditioning Combine chain into the guider. split_conds_to_windows is ON, so window 1 gets prompt 1, window 2 prompt 2, and so on. Edit a window's prompt on its PROMPT node.

Clowntext Hybrid Windows: keystone ON, capstone ON (capstone_step 4), finished_handoff ON, freenoise OFF (more variety).

Length and size are on PROMPT 1 (its LATENT is the one used). If you change the length, the window count changes and the prompts won't line up 1:1 any more.

The H3 Prompt IDE is unplugged.

Load your own subject picture in Picture 1 (only her gloved hands are seen). Picture 2 is not used.

widgets_values_named.text:
HOW TO USE (H3 Motion Context 0.6.2)

Use the buttons on the CLOWN CHAIN node, not ComfyUI's Run:
• Run / Re-roll: make the current clip again (change the seed for a new take)
• Approve: keep this clip and make the next one
• Chain: keep approving automatically (segments = how many clips, 0 = until Stop)
• Reset: back to the start (Load 0 / Save 1)
• Clear latents: delete the saved clips in the folder

First clip: Load 0 / Save 1 (nothing is loaded, it starts fresh).
Then Load 1 / Save 2, and so on. The buttons step these for you.

Load, Save and Clown Chain must stay inside the blue group or the buttons do nothing.

Each clip is saved to output/h3_ref2va/ already trimmed, so you can drop them on a timeline back to back.

Length must be 17k+5 frames (192 = 8 s, 243 = 10 s, 362 = 15 s).
Set resolution and length on the PROMPT node (480x864 = 9:16 at 0.5 MP).

Refer to pictures in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>... in the order they plug into ref_image_0, ref_image_1...

summary:
[reference generation] A first-person point-of-view ride on a roller coaster that races through outer space. The camera is the rider's eyes in the front seat of the cart; the only visible part of <Subject 1> is her two gloved hands and forearms, raised in front of the cart. One continuous 60-second shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (hands and forearms throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - keep her pink gloves, their stitching, and her rainbow cuffs from <Picture 1> sharp and unchanged for the whole ride.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action rendering, cinematic, with crisp fine detail and hard light from a distant white sun. Deep black space is filled with sharp pinpoint stars, a vivid purple-and-teal nebula with fine wispy filaments, and a huge orange ringed planet with clearly banded clouds and thin distinct rings.

[Shot 1] The camera is a first-person point of view from the front seat of a roller coaster cart, looking forward along the track. At the bottom of the frame is the front edge of the cart: a scratched red metal dashboard with a row of small round rivets, a white stenciled number "07", a small yellow warning label reading "KEEP HANDS INSIDE", and a padded black lap bar. <Subject 1> holds both arms raised high in front of the camera, her pink gloved hands open with the fingers spread, the rainbow cuffs bright at her wrists. The track ahead is a silver steel rail with evenly spaced riveted cross-ties and small glowing blue marker lights, twisting through space. The cart climbs a long slope with a steady clatter, the ringed planet rising ahead. It crests the top and plunges into a steep drop, and her hands shake and her fingers clench and spread in the rush. The track banks hard into a corkscrew; the whole view rolls clockwise as the stars and nebula spin around the frame, and her gloved hands sway with the turn. The cart speeds through a ring of floating grey asteroids covered in pitted craters, passing close enough to see the texture of their surfaces. The track swoops low over the ringed planet's rings, the fine bands of ice and dust streaking past beneath the cart. The cart races up a vertical loop, the view turning upside down with the planet overhead, then comes out level and dives again toward the nebula. Through every turn, drop and loop, her raised gloved hands stay in frame, the stitching on the gloves and the colors of the rainbow cuffs clear, while the riveted dashboard and the "07" and "KEEP HANDS INSIDE" labels stay fixed at the bottom of the frame. The camera shakes slightly at fast speed throughout the ride as the cart rattles along the rail.

overall_soundscape:
The loud metallic clatter of the cart's wheels on the steel rail, the ratcheting click of the lift chain on the climb, rushing whooshes on each drop and turn, and the woman's breathless delighted screams and laughter on the drops.
